hypothesis: A short continuation with independently authored comparison, conjunction and count supervision may improve rule transfer while preserving the original teacher task mix.
control: Original training split plus 1800 deterministic sampled training states with three questions each. No original validation states are replayed.
treatment: Original training split plus all 1800 filtered authored states, 5400 decisions. Hard exact targets are not fabricated teacher outputs.
interpretation: The intervention jointly changes content and adds exact supervision. This is not an isolated test of JSON shape or label certainty. One seed and a bounded optimization budget; do not infer convergence.
schedule: Linear warmup and linear decay, existing lr_lambda implementation
optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay=0.01, gradient clip=1.0, fused CUDA
loss: Existing option KL + 0.5 gold CE + canonical-order ordinal CDF loss. Original and new data retain their own targets.
selection: Include the unchanged step-zero model. Among checkpoints with original validation KL <= baseline + 0.02 and original teacher agreement >= baseline - 0.01, select the smallest weighted validation KL. New-data weight is 5400 / (29990 + 5400); the rest is original validation. No public, diagnostic or confirmation labels select a checkpoint.
calibration: T=1 only; no new temperature fitting in this bounded trial.
evaluation: After both arms complete and checkpoints are selected, evaluate the sealed 360-state authored confirmation set. Report the shared logic families and schemas that were filtered from training. Public benchmark and prior diagnostics are secondary regressions, never selection data.
compute: Laptop only under run_heavy.py, four CPU threads, unchanged thermal governor; two sequential workers, at most 12 minutes each. Preserve partial checkpoints on thermal or time stop. No additional RunPod resources or spending.
promotion: No automatic runtime promotion. The original public accuracy, language, calibration, packing and valid laptop latency gates remain required, plus fresh confirmation and competitive comparison.
